scripts.build: vite build --base=/arbres/mtl/dashboard/ && s3cmd sync --recursive --delete-removed --no-mime-magic dist/* s3://arbres/mtl/dashboard/ &&  s3cmd setacl --recursive s3://arbres/mtl/dashboard/ --acl-public
scripts.quebio-mtl: vite build  --mode mtl --base=/sites/all/modules/quebio/templates/arbres-pmtiles-react-mtl/ && mv dist/index.html dist/index.php && rsync -rvz -e 'ssh -p 535' --progress dist/* quebio@quebio.ca:/var/www/quebio.ca/quebio_new/sites/all/modules/quebio/templates/arbres-pmtiles-react-mtl/
scripts.quebio-qc: vite build --mode qc --base=/sites/all/modules/quebio/templates/arbres-pmtiles-react-qc/ && mv dist/index.html dist/index.php && rsync -rvz -e 'ssh -p 535' --progress dist/* quebio@quebio.ca:/var/www/quebio.ca/quebio_new/sites/all/modules/quebio/templates/arbres-pmtiles-react-qc/
scripts.pmtiles-mtl: docker compose -f docker/compose.yml --env-file docker/.env run --rm spatial sh /app/arbres-pmtiles-mtl.sh
scripts.pmtiles-qc: docker compose -f docker/compose.yml --env-file docker/.env run --rm spatial sh /app/arbres-pmtiles-qc.sh
